scientific_integrity: One single new structural claim with a proved infinite-parameter classification and two self-contained finite verification programs; previously known minimum domination cardinalities and bare counts are excluded from novelty.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for ordinary two-row ladders and adjacent one-token swaps of minimum dominating sets, not arbitrary one-token jumps or wider grids. An inaccessible foundational 2011 full text and an inaccessible 2024 Cartesian-product gamma-graph paper leave possible terminological priority overlap; finite computational corroboration is not the infinite proof.
title: Frozen optima and twin double-brooms in the domination exchange graph of ladders
